journey: Open Transform with Sign JWT selected below the option fold, then move the pointer into the first partly visible option.

environment.profile: fresh synthetic browser profile, example catalogs only
environment.network: existing browser fixture route isolation; HTTP caching disabled by routing

method.comparison: three sequential warm reopens per viewport before and after, after trigger hover settles; sample 20 animation frames around each opening/pointer entry
method.clock: browser requestAnimationFrame timestamps; only spatial changes compared
method.instrumentation: geometry reads plus normal Playwright failure tracing; separate Chrome timeline after comparison samples
method.limits: instrumented synthetic geometry observations, not latency, INP, physical display presentation, startup or heap measurements

cause: Bits UI 2.19.5 scrolls newly highlighted options into view even when pointer movement highlights a clipped row.
implementation: Suppress pointer highlight only on clipped options. Click, wheel, touch, keyboard and fully visible hover retain existing handlers. Cache clipping until row/scroll/resize changes; release observer and element reference when viewport unmounts.
tradeoff: A clipped option does not become the active highlight just from hover; its visible portion still selects on click. One ResizeObserver exists per open viewport; memory/startup impact not benchmarked.
correctness: Focused Brave and Chromium checks cover top/low popup placement, exact scroll stability, clipped-option clicking, native wheel scrolling, keyboard selection/cancellation, themes and motion. No full suite or CI monitoring.
